name: Lenticular Sheet
definition: A sheet consisting of a linear array of thick plano-convex cylindrical lenses called 'lenticules', optically analogous to a parallax barrier but transparent for higher optical efficiency.
summary: A lenticular sheet is a refractive optical component that directs light from a 2D screen into distinct viewing zones for glasses-free 3D, offering higher brightness than parallax barriers by refracting rather than blocking light.
